mapper.insert: insert into project (name, priority, type ,status,pm,pm_id,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, `desc`, create_man_id, create_man) values (#{name}, #{priority}, #{type},#{status}, #{pmName},#{pmId},#{planStartDate},#{planEndDate}, #{actualStartDate}, #{actualEndDate}, #{desc}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: select name, priority, type ,status,pm_id,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date,actual_end_date,`desc`, create_man_id, create_man,create_date,modify_date from project where id = #{id} and is_deleted=false
